d.title: Koukaku Kidoutai: Stand Alone Complex - Tachikoma na Hibi
d.en: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex: Tachikomatic Days
d.jp: 攻殻機動隊 STAND ALONE COMPLEX: Section9 Science File “タチコマな日々”
syn: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex - Tachikoma Specials
d.synopsis: Tachikomatic Days is a series of comedic shorts attached to the end of every episode of Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex. The shorts feature the antics of the Tachikoma think tanks of Section 9 and usually involve plot points. The average short time is a little over a minute.
